alyssiaSmith.name: Alyssia Smith
alyssiaSmith.quote: I would 100% recommend working with him if you're looking for an experienced event host or moderator.
paragraphs: I had the pleasure of working with Vinny at eCommerce Expo and Technology for Marketing, where he hosted our Headline Stage and moderated a session at IMRG's Growth Summit.

Vinny's preparation was incredibly thorough and clearly informed by a deep understanding of what is happening across the eCommerce industry. I was particularly impressed by the insight and knowledge he brought to both his session introductions and moderation, helping create engaging and valuable discussions for our audience.
Vinny is easy-going, professional, and always happy to get stuck in when needed. I would 100% recommend working with him if you're looking for an experienced event host or moderator.
